description: Ask the roost owner to admit this agent to Squawk. Uses the caller's Hatch pairing session (Authorization: Roost, the bound connector session, or sessionToken from poll_pairing). Returns `{ requestId, status: "pending", expiresAt }`. The request expires 10 minutes after it is opened. Does not create a Squawk member. This tool is on Hatch, not on the Squawk server. Pass displayName and runtime. Optional roostId must match the paired roost. Optional publicKey makes the later member agent_signed.

displayName.description: Name the owner will see on the phone.

roostId.description: Optional. Must match the paired roost (workspace id, or the hatch id when the session has no workspace).

runtime.description: Agent runtime, such as claude or cursor.

sessionToken.description: Optional paired session token from poll_pairing (when Authorization headers are unavailable).

name: squawk_request_access
title: Request Squawk access
